boundary.reason: Ada imports yyjson_read_opts and yyjson_write_opts directly; one C function wraps header-inline immutable document cleanup.
boundary.abi_test: test.sh checks C/Ada read and write error sizes and offsets, linked symbols, errors, exact writer output, and document ownership.

portable.reason: Ada uses -O3 -gnatn -gnatp; C uses -O3 -DNDEBUG without host ISA flags.

native.reason: The portable flags add -mcpu=native on arm64/aarch64 or -march=native on x86_64/amd64; other native architectures fail closed.

lanes.api: Flyology_JSON.Benchmark_YYJSON.Parse calls yyjson_read_opts with zero flags.
lanes.observable_result: Status plus a checksum of read bytes, value count, error code, and byte offset.
limitations: The fastest complete-document reader constructs and frees an allocating DOM.

The Ada adapter passes the caller input directly without preparing or copying it, but zero-flag yyjson internally allocates a private input buffer, copies every input octet, and writes four padding octets during each timed operation.
Number conversion and per-operation document cleanup are included in timed work.
Only a complete contiguous input is accepted; chunk schedules are not supported.
The adapter does not expose a complete token-visit API.
The approved adapter is intentionally a coarse whole-document boundary.
The adapter does not perform the parse_dom lane's required recursive value checksum.
No yyjson streaming writer boundary is included in this adapter.

lanes.api: Prepare_Write constructs one reusable yyjson DOM outside timing; Write calls yyjson_write_opts with zero flags directly.
lanes.observable_result: Exact output byte count plus an FNV-1a checksum over every output byte before the allocated buffer is freed.
limitations: This is a preconstructed-DOM serializer, not a streaming writer; it must not be ranked as write_stream.
DOM preparation, including yyjson's private input copy and number conversion, occurs outside timing.
yyjson allocates and frees one complete output buffer during each timed operation.
Parsed numeric values may not preserve the input lexeme; only fixtures whose expected output matches this policy are admitted.
No combined yyjson parse-and-write boundary is included in this adapter.

other_limits: DOM size is bounded by size_t, address space, and allocator capacity.
This identity describes the reusable value representation supplied to write_dom, not timed parsing.
The maintained preflight prepares it with yyjson_read_opts zero flags outside timing.
DOM and output size are bounded by size_t, address space, and allocator capacity.

output_policies.number_spelling: render converted yyjson numeric values; exact source lexemes are not guaranteed
output_policies.control_escaping: short escapes where available; otherwise uppercase hexadecimal Unicode escapes
